newsitem.title: USA: Wisconsin Central says to buy rail lines.
newsitem.headline: Wisconsin Central says to buy rail lines.

text.p: Wisconsin Central Transportation Corp said it signed a letter of intent to purchase about 220 route miles of Union Pacific Railroad Co rail lines, contiguous property and associated facilities from North Green Bay, Wis. to Ishpeming, Mich.; from Powers to Antoine, Mich.; from Quinnesec, Mich. to Niagara, Wis.; and from Cascade to Palmer, Mich.
The lines are commonly known as the Green Bay North Lines. Their purchase price was not disclosed, the railroad said.
The sale was expected to be consummated near year end.

The Green Bay North Lines carry substantial shipments of materials for the paper industry, and high volumes of iron ore used in steel-making from the Marquette ore range to Escanaba, Mich. for trans-shipment to vessels, Wisconsin Central.
The parties expect that a definitive agreement will be reached in early November 1996, the railroad said.
